title: 台湾総統がアフリカ電撃訪問　「中国の圧力」で4月下旬から延期
extracted_text: 台湾の頼清徳総統は2日、アフリカ・エスワティニ（旧スワジランド）に到着したと自身のフェイスブック（FB）に投稿した。当初は4月22日から訪問する予定だったが、頼氏の専用機の航路上にある3カ国が「中国の圧力」（総統府）で飛行許可を取り消したため、出発前日の21日に延期を発表していた。 エスワティニは台湾が外交関係を持つ12カ国のうち、アフリカ唯一の国。延期を受けて、頼氏が出席予定だった国王ムスワティ3世の即位40年式典には特使を派遣していた。 頼氏はFBへの投稿で、本来の訪問は「予期しない外部の力で延期した」が、台湾当局者の努力で訪問が実現したと説明。エスワティニとの友好深化に期待を寄せ、「自由と平和を愛する私たちは対立を求めないが、世界に向き合うことはあきらめない」と述べた。 総統府によると、許可を取り消していたのはインド洋の島国セーシェル、モーリシャス、マダガスカル。中国外務省は3カ国について「『一つの中国』原則を堅持する態度と方法を称賛する」と述べていた。 台湾紙・聯合報は30日に訪台していたエスワティニ国王特使の帰国に合わせて、頼氏が国王専用機に同乗したと報じた。【台北・林哲平】
translated_text: Taiwan President Lai Ching-te arrived in Africa Eswatini (formerly Swaziland) on the 2nd, posting about it on his Facebook. The visit had originally been planned to start on April 22nd, but three countries along the flight path of President Lai's special aircraft had their flight permissions canceled due to "Chinese pressure" from the Presidential Office, so it was announced on the 21st — the day before departure — that the visit would be postponed. Eswatini is the only African country among the 12 nations that maintain diplomatic relations with Taiwan. In response to the postponement, a special envoy had been sent to the 40th coronation ceremony of King Mswati III that President Lai had been scheduled to attend. In his Facebook post, Lai explained that the original visit had been "postponed due to unforeseen external forces," but that it was realized thanks to the efforts of Taiwan officials. He expressed hope for deepening friendship with Eswatini, saying, "We who love freedom and peace do not seek confrontation, but we will not give up facing the world." According to the Presidential Office, the countries that had canceled the permissions were the island nations of the Indian Ocean: Seychelles, Mauritius, and Madagascar. China's Foreign Ministry stated that it "praises the attitude and approach of the three countries in adhering to the 'One China' principle." Taiwan's United Daily News reported on the 30th that President Lai had traveled aboard the King's special aircraft, coinciding with the return of the Eswatini king special envoy who had been visiting Taiwan.
title_en: Taiwan President Makes Lightning Africa Visit — Postponed from Late April Due to 'Chinese Pressure'
